qc_notes.note: Gate 1 hold: inter-format disagreement on the west tower. The 16:9 master shows an exposed-stone/ashlar west tower with a broad green-copper spire and round-arched belfry openings, while the 4:5 master shows a whitewashed plastered west tower with a slimmer, darker spire above a louvered belfry stage and a front churchyard full of gravestones. The two formats read as different towers on the same church — the defining tower features do not agree. Held as Candidate until both formats are re-rendered to agree on the tower's identity.

Gate-1 hold resolved 2026-09-28 (Cosmo re-audit): the re-rendered masters show the SAME whitewashed west tower with broad green-copper spire and round-arched belfry openings with visible bells in both formats (the exposed-stone tower version is gone); all five gates re-verified pass. Hold cleared.
